headline: Gold prices drop by up to 3,323 taka per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has announced a new price list, reducing the cost of 22-carat gold to 221,966 taka per bhori.
details: The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased again, with a maximum reduction of 3,323 taka per bhori. The price for the highest quality 22-carat gold has been set at 221,966 taka per bhori.
The decision was made during a meeting of the permanent committee on price determination and monitoring of the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) on Thursday morning, July 9.
The new prices became effective from 10:00 AM today.
According to the new price list, 21-carat gold is now priced at 211,993 taka per bhori.
The price for 18-carat gold has been set at 182,075 taka per bhori, while traditional method gold is priced at 148,774 taka per bhori.
caption:
Gold prices fall again! 22-carat gold now costs 221,966 taka per bhori after a significant drop.

The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased again, with a maximum reduction of 3,323 taka per bhori. The price for the highest quality 22-carat gold has been set at 221,966 taka per bhori.

The decision was made during a meeting of the permanent committee on price determination and monitoring of the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) on Thursday morning, July 9.

The new prices became effective from 10:00 AM today.

According to the new price list, 21-carat gold is now priced at 211,993 taka per bhori.

The price for 18-carat gold has been set at 182,075 taka per bhori, while traditional method gold is priced at 148,774 taka per bhori.

headline_marked: Morocco star [[Ismael Saibari out of World Cup quarter-final]] against France
headline: Morocco star Ismael Saibari out of World Cup quarter-final against France
summary: The standout attacking midfielder, who scored in every group game, will miss the high-stakes clash due to a hamstring problem.
details: Morocco star Ismael Saibari will miss the World Cup quarter-final showdown against France, coach Mohamed Ouahbi confirmed on Wednesday.
Saibari has been one of the tournament's standout players, scoring in each of Morocco's three group games and converting the winning penalty against the Netherlands in the round of 32.
The attacking midfielder, who recently joined Bayern Munich for a reported 50 million euros, suffered a hamstring problem during the 3-0 win against Canada in the round of 16.
Coach Ouahbi stated that while Saibari is not fit for the quarter-final, he hopes the player will not be out for the rest of the competition.
The Atlas Lions are looking to avenge their 2-0 semi-final defeat to France in the 2022 World Cup, where they became the first African or Arab team to reach the last four.
Real Madrid star Brahim Diaz expressed confidence in the team's ability to compete with France, despite the loss of Saibari and the challenge of facing Kylian Mbappe.
caption:
A huge blow for Morocco! 🇲🇦 Their star man Ismael Saibari is officially out of the World Cup quarter-final against France.

Morocco star Ismael Saibari will miss the World Cup quarter-final showdown against France, coach Mohamed Ouahbi confirmed on Wednesday.

Saibari has been one of the tournament's standout players, scoring in each of Morocco's three group games and converting the winning penalty against the Netherlands in the round of 32.

The attacking midfielder, who recently joined Bayern Munich for a reported 50 million euros, suffered a hamstring problem during the 3-0 win against Canada in the round of 16.

Coach Ouahbi stated that while Saibari is not fit for the quarter-final, he hopes the player will not be out for the rest of the competition.

The Atlas Lions are looking to avenge their 2-0 semi-final defeat to France in the 2022 World Cup, where they became the first African or Arab team to reach the last four.

Real Madrid star Brahim Diaz expressed confidence in the team's ability to compete with France, despite the loss of Saibari and the challenge of facing Kylian Mbappe.
